metaDescription: Photograph a diseased leaf, stem or fruit and an AI suggests the likely problem and what to do. Always confirm with your local agriculture office.
title: Crop disease scan
subtitle: Take or upload a clear photo of an affected leaf, stem or fruit. The AI suggests the likely disease and what to do next.
dropActive: Drop the photo to use it
tips: Photograph one affected part up close, in daylight.
Hold the phone steady so the photo is sharp.
Let the leaf, stem or fruit fill most of the photo.
emptyBody: Choose a photo, then press “Scan this photo”.
confidenceNote: How sure the AI says it is — not a guarantee.
rateLimited: Too many scans in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
badImage: This file could not be read as a photo. Please use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
failed: The scan did not work. Please try again, or use a clearer photo.
disclaimer: This is an automatic suggestion, not a confirmed diagnosis. Before you spray or buy any medicine, confirm with your Upazila agriculture office (DAE) or your Sub-Assistant Agriculture Officer.
callCenter: You can also call the Krishi Call Center on {number}, 8 am to 8 pm, except Fridays, Saturdays and government holidays.
privacy: Your photo is sent to Google's Gemini AI for analysis. KrishiBangla does not save it.
